title: Disk space warning
expr: (max without (sleeping) (fleet_disk_used_percent) >= bool max without (sleeping) (fleet_disk_warning_percent)) * (max without (sleeping) (fleet_disk_used_percent) < bool max without (sleeping) (fleet_disk_critical_percent))

title: Btrfs allocation pressure
expr: (max without (sleeping) (fleet_btrfs_metadata_used_percent) >= bool 85) * (max without (sleeping) (fleet_btrfs_unallocated_bytes) < bool 10737418240) * (max without (sleeping) (fleet_btrfs_unallocated_bytes) >= bool 2147483648)
brief: Btrfs {{ $labels.mountpoint }} metadata is crowded and allocation headroom is low.

title: Btrfs allocation critical
brief: Btrfs {{ $labels.mountpoint }} has less than 2 GiB unallocated.
recovery: Btrfs {{ $labels.mountpoint }} has at least 2 GiB unallocated.

title: Offsite backup overdue
brief: No confirmed complete offsite backup within 30 hours.

title: Native backup export incomplete
brief: Native export {{ $labels.export }} is incomplete or unverified.

title: Reboot required
brief: Staged kernel or initrd differs from the running boot.
recovery: Booted kernel and initrd match the staged generation.

title: Headless reboot not converging
brief: Staged kernel or initrd pending on {{ $labels.host }} for over a day; the post-deploy and nightly reboot sequence did not converge.
recovery: Booted kernel and initrd match the staged generation.

title: Fleet host facts stale
expr: ((time() - fleet_health_collection_timestamp_seconds{collector="host"} > bool 180) or (max by(host)(node_uname_info) unless on(host) fleet_health_collection_timestamp_seconds{collector="host"})) and on(host) (time() - max by(host)(timestamp(node_uname_info)) < 120)
brief: Local host collector is missing or stale while Alloy is reporting.
recovery: Local health facts are fresh again.

title: Fleet disks facts stale
expr: ((time() - fleet_health_collection_timestamp_seconds{collector="disks"} > bool 1800) or (max by(host)(node_uname_info) unless on(host) fleet_health_collection_timestamp_seconds{collector="disks"})) and on(host) (time() - max by(host)(timestamp(node_uname_info)) < 120)
brief: Local disks collector is missing or stale while Alloy is reporting.
recovery: Local health facts are fresh again.

title: Cloud metric series near Free limit
brief: {{ printf "%.0f" $values.D.Value }} of 10,000 metric series; budget is 9,000.
